messages:
Maya Patel: heads-up — I booked the studio for our annual planning offsite on May 12-13. We need a final run-through of the hybrid tech flow and breakout ownership by next Tue.
Samir Chen: awesome. can we do a dry run Fri 9am PT? I want to test mics and the OBS scenes.
Jorge Alvarez: 9am PT works. i'll bring the checklist for stage layout and power distribution.
Kai Brooks: +1 for Friday. also, we should confirm simultaneous captions and recording permissions (legal asked).
Sarah Liao: noted — legal okayed recordings but asked for a single shared recording link and retention policy. will share policy doc.
Anika Rao: facilitation owners: who owns morning sync, priority game, and closing retro?
Maya Patel: assigning — morning sync: Anika, priority game: Jorge, closing retro: Kai. can each owner drop a 3-bullet runbook by EOD Thurs?
Anika Rao: I'll post the runbook. bullet format: goals, timebox, materials needed.
Jorge Alvarez: added note: priority game needs the customer vignette slides + sticker dots for voting. please confirm we have 200 dots.
Samir Chen: ops-bot: reserve 200 sticker dots? @ops-bot
ops-bot: reservation created: supply-order-4472. ETA 2 business days. :robot_face:
Samir Chen: sample OBS scene config i'll test in the dry run:
```
scene: hybrid_main
sources: camera_stage, remote_speakers, slides_capture
recording: enabled -> S3://redwood-offsites/2026/may12
```
Samir Chen: will share the config file in the drive link below after initial test.
Maya Patel: schedule note: day1 focused on context + roadmap tradeoffs (9:00-12:30), breakout sessions (1:30-4:30), synthesis (4:45-5:30)
Kai Brooks: can we move synthesis earlier if breakouts finish on time? also need 15m buffer for AV swaps.
Sarah Liao: added buffer in room schedule. also confirming remote breakout rooms will have a dedicated co-host for each group.
Anika Rao: volunteers for co-hosts? I'll take team ops co-host for breakout A.
Jorge Alvarez: i'll co-host breakout B (remote). Samir can you host breakout C's scene config so we don't lose time?
Samir Chen: yup i'll host C and leave a short playbook at the podium: `hotkeys`, `scene switch`, `mute remote`.
Maya Patel: prework deadline: everyone to fill the 3 priority proposals doc by May 5. I'll ping slack thread with Drive link.
Sarah Liao: reminder: travel reimbursements — people arriving day before need to file expense pre-approval. I'll send template.
Anika Rao: facilitation run-through Friday agenda: 9:00 tech check, 9:30 facilitator script run, 10:15 mock priority game, 11:00 open issues.
Maya Patel: perfect. if no blockers, i'll finalize the AV vendor call and venue runbook today. please react :thumbsup: when you confirm your runbook deliverable by Thu EOD.
Jorge Alvarez: :thumbsup:
Samir Chen: :thumbsup:
Kai Brooks: :thumbsup:
Sarah Liao: :thumbsup:
Anika Rao: :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: thanks — will post links and the final schedule after the dry run.
